svg.desc: Frame 7 of 9, Spar review: $ spar gate docs/reviews/password-link/01-candidate \ --expect-head e01fdf1 --out docs/reviews/password-link/gate.json gate.json: "state": "complete" $ ha note docs/specs/password-link review \ --gate docs/reviews/password-link/gate.json noted: review (seq 5) — Record the gate. The gate covers the last commit. ha done needs it for standard and strict goals. Review records stay in a folder Git ignores. Fictional example; not a recording of a real run.
